subject: MedGenix: short-term trial burst credits for RFP bake-off
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medgenix.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short-term credits to cover next-week RFP bake-off

Hi Soojin,

Quick context: MedGenix has an RFP bake-off next Wednesday where we're evaluating three vendors head-to-head (including one large cloud provider). Our engineering team needs to run a concentrated set of large-scale benchmarks (long context and multi-turn) over a 10-day window to validate latency and hallucination characteristics.

Current account usage will exhaust our sandbox quota before the bake-off. Can Redwood provide a short-term trial/top-up (one-off) to cover the spike so our team can complete the tests?

What would help us: approximate token allocation you can provision, how long it will be active, and any T&Cs we should be aware of. We can share a minimal SOW and baseline usage (attached). Decision timeline is tight — would appreciate confirmation by EOD Tuesday.

Attachments: MedGenix_RFP_SOW.pdf, usage_baseline_aug.csv

Thanks,
--
Liam O'Connor
Senior Procurement Manager
MedGenix Health
liam.oconnor@medgenix.com
+1 415 555 0248
From: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medgenix.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term credits to cover next-week RFP bake-off

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads-up and the SOW. Appreciate the tight timeline.

A few clarifying Qs so we can size this correctly:
- Are you running against our hosted Redwood API or do you need Dedicated/Private capacity for data isolation?
- Estimated token spend (or number of long-sequence runs) you expect over the 10-day window?
- Any compliance constraints (e.g., cannot send PHI) beyond the standard SOC2 we already discussed?

Provisional offer: we can provision a 100k-token trial burst for 14 days as a bridge while we evaluate the formal trial top-up. This would be conditional on a quick acceptance of our trial terms (I can send a short one-page). If you confirm that you need more than 100k, flag the exact amount and I will escalate.

I[0m'm copying Vanessa (sales lead) and Marcus (solutions) to weigh in on the amount and any procurement paperwork. Happy to jump on a 20-minute call tomorrow morning to sync with your engineers.

Best,
--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL — Approved provisional top-up (conditions)

Soojin / Marcus — quick internal note before we finalize the external: Approved to offer up to 150k tokens for 14 days for MedGenix given the competitive bake-off. Conditions:
- Trial credit expires 14 days from activation; non-recurring.
- Customer must sign the one-page trial terms (I attached a checklist).
- No PHI may be sent to hosted endpoints; if they need to process PHI we must route to Private and follow the onboarding flow.

Action items for external reply: offer 150k tokens, reiterate the PHI restriction, attach the trial terms and a DocuSign link, and propose kickoff call times (tomorrow 9:30–11:30 PT or Wednesday 8:00–10:00 PT). Also request an estimate of test-run types (max sequence length) so Marcus can pre-configure quantization/batching settings to keep latency within SLOs.

Attachment: trial_credit_terms.txt

Vanessa
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

Cc: Dr. Priya Menon <priya.menon@medgenix.com>

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround and Vanessa's internal note (copied). MedGenix accepts the provisional 150k-token allocation and the 14-day window. We will not send PHI to hosted endpoints.

Next steps from our side:

- Priya (cc) will coordinate the benchmark schedule with Marcus — we expect several long-context runs (avg length ~4k tokens, some up to 8k).
- Can Redwood confirm when the credits will be active? We[0m'd like activation at 08:00 PT on Friday to align with our test window.
